hooks.name: chamber-regression
hooks.description: After a spec task, make the agent prove the modem still passes the test chamber. Agent prompt: uses credits, so it ships disabled. Turn it on (set enabled to true) once `npm run chamber:quick` exists (milestone M2).

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. If, and only if, that task changed a file under packages/modem, packages/protocol or packages/chamber: run `npm run chamber:quick` now and report its one-line summary. If any preset is below its mark in chamber/thresholds.json, treat it as a regression caused by the task: find the cause and fix the code before you end your turn. You must not edit chamber/thresholds.json, chamber/presets.json or any test to make it pass. If the task touched none of those folders, do nothing and say nothing about the chamber.
